item.title: Artificial intelligence: loss scenarios and claims developments
item.description:
# Artificial intelligence: loss scenarios and claims developments ## A unique risk profile Unlike previous technology revolutions, AI is being adopted simultaneously across virtually all industries and geographies. AI also operates probabilistically, meaning errors are inevitable even in well-designed systems.
## AI as a risk management tool In financial services, AI-driven fraud detection systems identify suspicious transactions in real time, helping prevent payment fraud, account takeovers, and money laundering. In cyber security, AI is increasingly used to detect abnormal network activity, identify compromised credentials, and uncover emerging attack patterns before significant damage occurs.
Manufacturing companies use predictive maintenance models to detect early signs of equipment failure. Supply chain organizations employ AI to monitor suppliers and logistics networks, enabling earlier identification of disruption risks and more resilient business continuity planning. AI is also enhancing regulatory compliance by continuously monitoring large volumes of transactions, communications, and records, helping organizations identify potential compliance breaches at an earlier stage and reducing the likelihood of regulatory action.

item.description:
# Artificial Intelligence and Human Rights: Protecting Human Dignity in the Age of AI Artificial intelligence is rapidly transforming the way people learn, communicate, create, access information and participate in public life.
Through the story of a child fleeing conflict in search of safety, the film explores themes of war, migration, poverty, modern slavery, children's rights and human dignity, while illustrating how artificial intelligence can be harnessed as a creative tool to promote inclusion, cultural diversity, sustainable development and peaceful societies.
